anomaly.description: Position feed returned the same (or a near-identical, <1m) fix for ~81 continuous minutes (2026-07-02T03:49:07Z to 2026-07-02T05:10:36Z, 918 polls at ~5.3s cadence, two runs of 3033s and 1851s separated by a single micro-update) before resuming normal ~9s refresh. This is roughly an order of magnitude longer than the worst stall seen in any diagnostic-tool session (max 51.2s) or the other capture sessions (max 102s).
anomaly.context: User note: this Android device was stationary — left in a room — for that period, so the identical coordinates are expected; the relevant part is only that lastSeen behaviour, not a moving-device freeze.
